{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS086 |prevtitle=Double Dragonair |nextcode=PS088 |nexttitle=The Beedrill All and End All |series=Yellow |colorscheme=Yellow}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Rhyhorn Rising |title_ja=VSサイホーン |title_ro=VS Sihorn |image=PS087.png |scheme=Yellow |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 87 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|7}} |pub2=VIZ Media monthly issue |pub2-data=Chapter 47 in [[Lance's Charge]] |pub3=VIZ Media full volume |pub3-data=Adventure 87 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|7}} |location=[[Cerise Island]] }} '''Rhyhorn Rising''' (Japanese: '''VSサイホーン''' ''VS {{tt|Sihorn|Rhyhorn}}'') is the 87th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 47th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Yellow}} is certain that [[Lance]] could not have survived from his fall into the lava, though a bubble-encased Lance proves otherwise. With his {{p|Dragonair}} and {{p|Gyarados}} firing {{m|Bubble Beam}}, Lance creates a storm of bubbles that refract light to hide him from sight, injuring Yellow's arm and forcing her to have [[Kitty]] bind it in place with {{m|String Shot}}. Unable to see Lance, Yellow and her Pokémon are forced to retreat. Yellow has Kitty cover the volcano crater in String Shot to form a net that is doused by her {{p|Omanyte}}'s water and then linked to [[Ratty]]'s sensitive whiskers. Upon Lance triggering the net, Ratty signals to [[Pika]] to send electricity down the net, forcing Lance's bubble into view. Yellow orders her {{p|Doduo}} to break the bubble with {{m|Drill Peck}}, but the attack proves too weak. Lance mocks Yellow for attempting to break a bubble that withstood lava and sends Yellow flying, but she is saved by the sudden appearance of {{adv|Giovanni}}. Yellow begs Giovanni to let her fight, saying that as a Trainer of {{ci|Viridian}}, only she can deal with Lance. Giovanni reveals himself to also be from Viridian City and glares across the crater at Lance. ==Major events== * {{adv|Giovanni}} appears. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Giovanni}} * [[Lance]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Raticate}} ([[Ratty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Doduo}} ([[Dody]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Graveler}} (Gravvy; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Omanyte}} ([[Omny]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Caterpie}} ([[Kitty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Rhyhorn}} ({{adv|Giovanni}}'s) * {{p|Gyarados}} ({{OP|Lance|Gyarados}}) * {{p|Dragonair}} ([[Lance]]'s; ×2) ==Trivia== * This chapter is included in [[The Best of Pokémon Adventures: Yellow]]. ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{yellow color light}}|bordercolor={{yellow color}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 鐵甲犀牛|VS Rhyhorn}} (Taiwan)
